_comment: Lead ladder baseline (LEAD_LADDER_METHODOLOGY_20261010.md section 2) with the L1 (folding) and L4 (invariant base) toggles. The degree is overridden per rung by run_baseline.sh; K_0 is selected with --koblitz-a 0 on the CLI, which the sweep inherits. A matrix rather than an explicit list because ic bench treats an empty matrix as one empty configuration and aborts; every configuration draws the same planted targets from the seed, so the arms are paired, and the counts are deterministic so no A/A arm is needed.
